title: Australian Turkey and Ham Bowl
description: A delicious and hearty bowl filled with juicy turkey, fatty ham, and other tasty ingredients. Perfect for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Season the turkey breast with salt and pepper.
Place the turkey breast on a baking tray and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the turkey is cooking, cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced red onion, and cooked brown rice.
Once the turkey is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Add the sliced turkey and fatty ham to the bowl, and drizzle with balsamic glaze.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Cooking time includes resting time for the turkey.
Adjust cooking time based on turkey size and thickness.
